import heapq

def main():
    N = int(input())
    Vs = [float('inf')] * N
    Es = []
    for i in range(N - 1):
        Ai, Bi, Xi = map(int, input().split())
        Es.append((Ai, Bi, Xi - 1))
    Vs[0] = 0

    U = []
    heapq.heappush(U, (0, 0))
    while U:
        current_cost, now = heapq.heappop(U)
        if now == N - 1:
            break
        Ai, Bi, Xi = Es[now]
        # Move to the next stage
        new_cost = current_cost + Ai
        if new_cost < Vs[now + 1]:
            Vs[now + 1] = new_cost
            heapq.heappush(U, (new_cost, now + 1))
        # Move to stage Xi
        new_cost = current_cost + Bi
        if new_cost < Vs[Xi]:
            Vs[Xi] = new_cost
            heapq.heappush(U, (new_cost, Xi))

    print(Vs[N - 1])
